original.verdict_vo: Real answer: number 2, because cave bears frequently hibernated in caves through winter. The open overhang is probably safer.

fact.text: Cave bears frequently used caves to hibernate during the winter months.
fact.source_sentence: This reflects the views of experts that cave bears spent more time in caves than the brown bear, frequently using them to hibernate during the winter months.

original.description: Glacial Europe, a night far below freezing, and eight places to sleep. The cosy-looking caves were not always empty. Pick your number before the verdict.
